message: Invoice #9104 billed us $2,150 but our agreed rate is $1,400/month. Please correct this before our finance close on Friday.
We had an outage with ArcVault last year, but everything has been fine since. Quick question: how do I add a new admin user to our workspace?
One of our users, Maria, can't see the dashboard: it just shows a blank page for her. Everyone else on the team is fine.
The CSV export button throws error 500 every time, and on top of that I was charged twice for March ($49 each).
Bonjour, depuis 9h ce matin aucun de nos 40 utilisateurs ne peut se connecter à ArcVault. Toute l'équipe est bloquée.
